placement: Append optional cells into the same passport-facts definition list as the four core facts. Same borders, padding, type sizes and responsive columns. Missing values create no cells; when all are missing the original four cells remain. An odd final cell spans the available row.

fields.label: Год сдачи
fields.rules: Normalize spacing in 2 030; require a four-digit year 1900–2199. Zero/missing/placeholder hidden. A past year does not imply Сдан.

fields.label: Отделка
fields.rules: Use explicit meaningful text; blank and placeholders hidden. Без отделки and explicit Нет are meaningful values, not empty.

fields.label: Высота потолков
fields.rules: Positive numeric value gains metres; explicit text/ranges with positive numbers preserved, zero or missing hidden. Do not infer from floor count or general description.

rendering: preview/js/optional-characteristics.js exposes BarnProjectCharacteristics.render(root, publicValues). Root #project-optional-facts is now the common passport definition list. It replaces only data-optional-fact cells and preserves the four core facts. Uses textContent; only public values belong in the payload.

preview.provenance: Year 0 and missing finishing from prior Intrum audit; exact ceiling text was not retained by that audit, so the static preview height is checked against the official project page, not claimed to be a new CRM export.
preview.historical_value_not_reused: Older saved page showed upper floors 3.95m; current official page gives up to 7.4m.
